name: Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald
oracle_text:
Flying
When Silver Surfer enters, you may search your library for a card named Galactus, Devourer of Worlds, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Whenever Silver Surfer deals combat damage to a player, until the end of your next turn, target creature attacks that player each combat if able.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Silver Surfer deals combat damage to a player, until the end of your next turn, target creature attacks that player each combat if able.

needs.what: an attack requirement on a target creature that names a specific player it must attack (the player the trigger's combat damage was dealt to), enforced each combat until the end of the effect controller's next turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: must_attack takes only objects and a duration of this_turn or next_combat, names no defender and cannot last 'until the end of your next turn' across every combat; goad forces attacks on a player OTHER than the goader and expires at the goader's next turn rather than its end; must_attack_planeswalker targets a planeswalker; the attacks_if_able static is a permanent self-filter with no defender or duration
